name: sdlc-skills
description: One plugin for coding agents: sdlc makes sure someone other than the author attacks each change and a machine decides when it is done. An optional second, working-agreement, sets how the agent works with you.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Whoever made the change, someone else attacks it, and a machine decides when it is done. Four hooks lock committed tests, run your check before the agent can stop, cap AGENTS.md and gate first-seen dependencies. Three fresh agents attack designs and tests, review the diff and verify it against the running app. Two short skills: build, where you author to learn or the agent authors to delegate, and onboard, which sets up the check, mutation testing, property-based tests and a sandbox.

plugins.name: working-agreement
plugins.description: Optional house rules for how the agent works with you: keep it simple, look facts up instead of asking, one decision per question that yes accepts, and explanations that lead with what a thing means for you and a concrete case before the mechanism and its name. One hook adds them at session start.
